title: Glasses Off
setting: Late afternoon at home. Kenji, a high-school boy, comes in from school without his glasses, and his mother notices straight away.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: are? kenji, megane kaketenai ja nai. dou shita no?
lines.ja: あれ？ケンジ、メガネかけてないじゃない。どうしたの？
lines.kana: あれ？けんじ、めがねかけてないじゃない。どうしたの？
lines.english: Huh? Kenji, you're not wearing your glasses. What happened?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: kyou, gakkou de zutto megane hazushiteta.
lines.ja: 今日、学校でずっとメガネ外してた。
lines.kana: きょう、がっこうでずっとめがねはずしてた。
lines.english: I had them off all day at school today.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: e, nande? megane nai to, nanimo mienai desho?
lines.ja: え、なんで？メガネないと、何も見えないでしょ？
lines.kana: え、なんで？めがねないと、なにもみえないでしょ？
lines.english: What, why? You can't see a thing without them, can you?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: betsu ni. megane nai hou ga, ii kana tte.
lines.ja: 別に。メガネないほうが、いいかなって。
lines.kana: べつに。めがねないほうが、いいかなって。
lines.english: No reason. I just thought I might look better without them.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: a, wakatta. kakko tsuketakatta n desho. suki na ko demo iru no?
lines.ja: あ、わかった。かっこつけたかったんでしょ。好きな子でもいるの？
lines.kana: あ、わかった。かっこつけたかったんでしょ。すきなこでもいるの？
lines.english: Oh, I get it. You wanted to look cool, didn't you? Is there a girl you like or something?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: chigau tte. sore yori, kyou wa minna no mae de haji o kaita n da yo.
lines.ja: ちがうって。それより、今日はみんなの前で恥をかいたんだよ。
lines.kana: ちがうって。それより、きょうはみんなのまえではじをかいたんだよ。
lines.english: I said no. Anyway, I made a fool of myself in front of everyone today.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: asa, ano ko da to omotte, kakko tsukete koe kaketa n da.
lines.ja: 朝、あの子だと思って、かっこつけて声かけたんだ。
lines.kana: あさ、あのこだとおもって、かっこつけてこえかけたんだ。
lines.english: This morning I thought I saw her, so I played it cool and said hi.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: ano ko? yappari iru n ja nai. sore de?
lines.ja: あの子？やっぱりいるんじゃない。それで？
lines.kana: あのこ？やっぱりいるんじゃない。それで？
lines.english: Her? So there is someone! And then?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: sore ga, sensei datta. tomodachi ni metcha baka ni sareta.
lines.ja: それが、先生だった。友だちにめっちゃバカにされた。
lines.kana: それが、せんせいだった。ともだちにめっちゃばかにされた。
lines.english: It was a teacher. My friends totally made fun of me.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: e, sensei ni? sore wa omoshiroi ne.
lines.ja: え、先生に？それはおもしろいね。
lines.kana: え、せんせいに？それはおもしろいね。
lines.english: What, to a teacher? Well, that's funny.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: okaasan made baka ni shinaide yo.
lines.ja: お母さんまでバカにしないでよ。
lines.kana: おかあさんまでばかにしないでよ。
lines.english: Don't you make fun of me too, Mom.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: gomen gomen, baka ni shitenai yo. hazukashikatta ne.
lines.ja: ごめんごめん、バカにしてないよ。恥ずかしかったね。
lines.kana: ごめんごめん、ばかにしてないよ。はずかしかったね。
lines.english: Sorry, sorry, I'm not making fun of you. That must have been embarrassing.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: un. anna ni haji o kaita no, hajimete da yo.
lines.ja: うん。あんなに恥をかいたの、初めてだよ。
lines.kana: うん。あんなにはじをかいたの、はじめてだよ。
lines.english: Yeah. I've never made such a fool of myself.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: dakara, kakko tsukenakute ii no yo. megane kaketete mo, kenji wa kakkoii n da kara.
lines.ja: だから、かっこつけなくていいのよ。メガネかけてても、ケンジはかっこいいんだから。
lines.kana: だから、かっこつけなくていいのよ。めがねかけてても、けんじはかっこいいんだから。
lines.english: That's why you don't need to act cool. You're cool with your glasses on too, you know.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: sore, ato de ano ko ni mo iwareta. megane kaketeru hou ga, kakkoii tte.
lines.ja: それ、あとであの子にも言われた。メガネかけてるほうが、かっこいいって。
lines.kana: それ、あとであのこにもいわれた。めがねかけてるほうが、かっこいいって。
lines.english: She said that too, later. That I look cooler with my glasses on.

lines.speaker: okaasan
lines.romaji: hora ne. jaa, ashita wa chanto megane kakete ikinasai.
lines.ja: ほらね。じゃあ、明日はちゃんとメガネかけて行きなさい。
lines.kana: ほらね。じゃあ、あしたはちゃんとめがねかけていきなさい。
lines.english: See? Then tomorrow, you wear your glasses to school.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: un. mou haji wa kakitakunai shi.
lines.ja: うん。もう恥はかきたくないし。
lines.kana: うん。もうはじはかきたくないし。
lines.english: Yeah. I don't want to make a fool of myself again anyway.

choices.english: Kenji's friends made fun of his glasses, so he's going to stop wearing them to school.
Kenji took his glasses off to look cool, mistook a teacher for the girl he likes, and will wear them again tomorrow.
Kenji played it cool with the girl he likes, but she told him he looks better without glasses.

questions.explanation: Lines 1-5: Kenji kept his glasses off all day at school, and his mother guesses he wanted to look cool for a girl. Lines 8-10: he called out to someone he took for the girl, but it was a teacher, and his friends made fun of him. Lines 16-18: the girl later told him he looks cooler with his glasses on, so he'll wear them tomorrow. A is wrong: his friends made fun of him for greeting a teacher, not for his glasses, and he's going back to wearing them (lines 17-18). C is wrong: the person he greeted was a teacher, not the girl (line 10), and the girl said he looks cooler with glasses, not without (line 16).

questions.english: You tell Kenji you don't know how to send a photo from your new phone. He smirks and says, "e, sore mo shiranai no? uso desho?" Tell him not to make fun of you, using baka ni suru.
questions.ja: え、それも知らないの？うそでしょ？
questions.kana: え、それもしらないの？うそでしょ？
questions.romaji: e, sore mo shiranai no? uso desho?
questions.answer: Protest with baka ni shinaide (yo), 'don't make fun of me', the way Kenji says it to his mother. Or call him out with baka ni shiteru desho (you're making fun of me, aren't you).

modelAnswers.romaji: chotto, baka ni shinaide yo. shiranai mono wa shiranai n da kara.
modelAnswers.ja: ちょっと、バカにしないでよ。知らないものは知らないんだから。
modelAnswers.english: Hey, don't make fun of me. I just don't know, all right?

modelAnswers.romaji: baka ni shiteru desho. jaa, kenji ga oshiete yo.
modelAnswers.ja: バカにしてるでしょ。じゃあ、ケンジが教えてよ。
modelAnswers.english: You're making fun of me, aren't you? Fine, then you show me.

questions.explanation: After his friends made fun of him (tomodachi ni metcha baka ni sareta, line 10), Kenji tells his mother okaasan made baka ni shinaide yo when she finds the story funny (line 12), and she answers baka ni shitenai yo (line 13). baka ni suru is mocking someone or treating them as stupid, which is what Kenji's smirk does here. karakau (tease) is lighter, for playful teasing, and warau only means laugh, so warawanaide is 'don't laugh', not 'don't make fun of me'. Keep the ni: baka ni suru, literally 'treat as a fool'.

questions.english: At a meeting today you called a new coworker by the wrong name in front of everyone. When you get home, your mother asks, "dou shita no? genki nai ne." Tell her what happened, using haji o kaku.
questions.ja: どうしたの？元気ないね。
questions.kana: どうしたの？げんきないね。
questions.romaji: dou shita no? genki nai ne.
questions.answer: Say you made a fool of yourself in front of everyone: minna no mae de haji o kaita (or haji o kaichatta). To say how it felt, add hazukashikatta.

modelAnswers.romaji: un. kyou, kaigi de haji o kaichatta. metcha hazukashikatta.
modelAnswers.ja: うん。今日、会議で恥をかいちゃった。めっちゃ恥ずかしかった。
modelAnswers.english: Yeah. I made a fool of myself in a meeting today. It was so embarrassing.

modelAnswers.romaji: minna no mae de haji kaita no. atarashii hito no namae, machigaechatta.
modelAnswers.ja: みんなの前で恥かいたの。新しい人の名前、間違えちゃった。
modelAnswers.english: I embarrassed myself in front of everyone. I got the new person's name wrong.

questions.explanation: Kenji uses haji o kaku three times about his mix-up: minna no mae de haji o kaita (line 6), anna ni haji o kaita no, hajimete (line 14) and mou haji wa kakitakunai (line 18). haji o kaku is the incident; how it felt is hazukashii, which his mother says in line 13 (hazukashikatta ne). 'I embarrassed myself' word for word, jibun o hazukashiku shita, isn't said in Japanese. This kaku is the one in ase o kaku (break out in sweat), not kaku 'write'. In casual speech the o can drop (haji kaita), and -chatta adds that it went wrong.

questions.english: When Kenji says he kept his glasses off all day, his mother says, "kakko tsuketakatta n desho." What does she mean?
questions.ja: お母さんは、ケンジのことをどう思いましたか？
questions.kana: おかあさんは、けんじのことをどうおもいましたか？
questions.romaji: okaasan wa, kenji no koto o dou omoimashita ka?

choices.english: She thinks he was bragging to his friends about something.
She's telling him he looks cool without his glasses.
She thinks he was trying to look cool, maybe for a girl.

questions.explanation: Line 5: kakko tsukeru is putting on a cool act, trying to look good, and she follows it with suki na ko demo iru no? (is there a girl you like?). Kenji does it again in line 8 (kakko tsukete koe kaketa: played it cool and said hi), and in line 15 she tells him kakko tsukenakute ii (you don't need to act cool). A is jiman suru, boasting in words about what you have or did, and nobody brags here. B mixes it up with kakkoii, actually being cool: in line 15 she says he's cool with his glasses on (megane kaketete mo, kenji wa kakkoii), not without them.

newWords.english: can see, be visible (mienai: can't see)
kid; here, a girl (suki na ko: a girl you like; ano ko: that girl, her)
cool, good-looking (being cool, as opposed to kakko tsukeru, acting cool)
